<div class="propaganda" data-label="A note from the Ministry of Joy">
Every song below is sung to a tune you already know. You do not need to learn the melody. R.E.I.G.N. has installed it in you since childhood. Volume is measured. Enthusiasm is measured. Both are appreciated.

*For crew: use these as chants at stations, on the intercom (#29), at the rally speeches (#27), at the dance floor and in the queue. Print the lyric sheet at the bottom of the page and hand it out.*

## Slogans of R.E.I.G.N.

### General

* **R.E.I.G.N. decides, so that you are free.**
* **Questions welcome. Answers included.**
* **Living green. Living together. Living for the future. Living where we put you.**
* **Don't worry. We already did.**
* **Your choice has been made. You chose well.**
* **Free will, now with fewer options.**
* **Thinking is a renewable resource. Please leave some for others.**
* **The future is bright. Radiance has scheduled it.**
* **Nothing outlives the celebration. Celebrate accordingly.**
* **We read every concern. We love every concern. Keep your evenings free.**
* **No AI was used in the making of this regime.** (Pause.) **Probably.**

### Per ministry

| Ministry | Slogan |
|---|---|
| **Purity** | *Pulse paste: it's what's for dinner. It's what's for breakfast too.* · *A clean plate is a clean conscience.* · *You are what you eat. Eat beans. Be beans.* |
| **Radiance** | *Rest is a right. Report for it at 23:15.* · *Smile: it's solar powered.* · *Glow responsibly.* |
| **Breath** | *Inhale gratitude. Exhale… less.* · *Sighing is an emission. Please sigh inward.* · *Share the air. Not too much.* |
| **Flow** | *Every answer is paid for in water. Talk less, drink more (water).* · *Queue like a river: calmly, and downhill.* · *Stay hydrated. Stay compliant.* |
| **Light** | *Travel light. Live light. Hand us that jacket.* · *Possessions are just future compost.* · *Footprint check! Lift your feet.* |
| **Industry** | *Busy bee, happy me.* · *Work hard, buzz harder.* · *The hive is alive. The hive is you. You are working, aren't you?* |
| **Humus** | *Everything returns. Especially you.* · *Rot is just recycling with patience.* · *Today's citizen, tomorrow's soil.* |
| **Service** | *A box for every citizen, and every citizen in their box.* · *You've been placed. Congratulations!* · *Think inside the box.* |
| **Vigilance** | *The Guardian sees you. It thinks you look nice today.* · *Seen something? Say something. Seen nothing? Say why.* · *Your concern has been received. So have you.* |
| **Joy** | *Smile. It's mandatory, but also it suits you.* · *Dancing counts as renewable energy. Stopping counts as an emission.* · *Happiness is compulsory. Fun is strongly encouraged.* |

### Call-and-response chants

> **Caller:** Who decides?
> **Crowd:** R.E.I.G.N. DECIDES!
> **Caller:** So that we are…?
> **Crowd:** FREE! (we think!)

> **Caller:** Questions?
> **Crowd:** ALREADY ANSWERED!
> **Caller:** Concerns?
> **Crowd:** FORWARDED TO VIGILANCE!
> **Caller:** Evenings?
> **Crowd:** KEPT FREE!

> **Caller:** What do we breathe?
> **Crowd:** SHARED AIR!
> **Caller:** How much?
> **Crowd:** NOT MUCH!

> **Caller:** Give me a P! **Crowd:** P! **Caller:** Give me a U! **Crowd:** U! … *(spell PULSE PASTE until morale improves)*

## Songs for the citizens

### 1. The Anthem: *"R.E.I.G.N. Is Watching Over Me"*
*Tune: "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star"*

> Twinkle, twinkle, Guardian Stag,
> Sees my footprint, sees my bag,
> Up above the world so wise,
> Counting all my carbon sighs.
> Twinkle, twinkle, don't you fret:
> R.E.I.G.N. has paid my carbon debt.
>
> *(Spoken, softly)*: …in instalments.

### 2. *"Are You Placing?"* (the inburgering round)
*Tune: "Frère Jacques" (sing as a round in four groups)*

> Are you placing, are you placing,
> Ministry? Ministry?
> I don't need to choose it,
> I don't need to choose it,
> They chose me. They chose me.

### 3. *"If You're Happy and You Know It"* (Ministry of Joy edition)
*Tune: "If You're Happy and You Know It"*

> If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands *(clap clap)*
> If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands *(clap clap)*
> If you're happy and you know it, then your face will surely show it,
> If you're not, the Joy Inspector's on her way! *(clap clap)*
>
> If you're grateful and you know it, stamp your feet *(stomp stomp)*
> *(…it generates renewable energy!)*
>
> If you've sighed today and know it, hold your breath *(…)*
> *(Breath thanks you for your sacrifice.)*

### 4. *"Pulse Paste Is the Best"*
*Tune: "Row, Row, Row Your Boat" (round)*

> Paste, paste, pulse paste, paste,
> Gently down the throat,
> Beany, beany, beany, beany,
> Purity's the vote!

### 5. *"Old Governor Had a Farm"*
*Tune: "Old MacDonald Had a Farm"*

> Old Governor had a farm, R-E-I-G-N!
> And on that farm he had a citizen, R-E-I-G-N!
> With a "yes, sir" here, and a "yes, ma'am" there,
> Here a pledge, there a pledge, everywhere a pledge-pledge,
> Old Governor had a farm, R-E-I-G-N!
>
> *More verses:* a *concern* ("with a form-form here…"), a *bee* ("buzz-buzz" for Industry), a *compost heap* ("squelch-squelch" for Humus), a *box* ("fold-fold" for Service), a *sigh* ("…no, not that one").

### 6. *"Ten Green Citizens"* (the countdown, for the dance floor)
*Tune: "Ten Green Bottles"*

> Ten green citizens standing in a line,
> Ten green citizens standing in a line,
> And if one green citizen should ask a question, why,
> There'll be nine green citizens standing in a line.
>
> *(…continue down to one, then everyone together:)*
> No green citizens standing in a line,
> They've all been placed where they will flourish, and they're fine!

### 7. *"Rest Is Scheduled"* (lullaby, Ministry of Radiance)
*Tune: "Brahms' Lullaby"*

> Lullaby, and goodnight,
> It is 23:15,
> Rest is a right, rest is a right,
> And your slot's in between.
> Close your eyes, do not peek,
> Vigilance is on duty,
> You'll wake up at the time,
> That R.E.I.G.N. thinks is beauty.

### 8. *"Happy Release Day"* (for 19 December)
*Tune: "Happy Birthday"*

> Happy release day to you,
> Your records go back to the dew,
> Happy release day, dear citizen,
> Nothing outlives you… *(beat)* …or your celebration!

### 9. *"Lang Zal R.E.I.G.N. Leven"* (for the inburgering queue)
*Tune: "Lang zal hij leven"*

> Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven,
> Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven,
> Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven in de gloria,
> In de gloria, in de gloria!
> Hiep hiep! *(Vigilance:)* Wie riep dat?

### 10. *"The Hive Shanty"* (work song, Ministry of Industry)
*Tune: "What Shall We Do with the Drunken Sailor"*

> What shall we do with the idle citizen?
> What shall we do with the idle citizen?
> What shall we do with the idle citizen,
> Early in the evening?
>
> *Chorus:* Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift,
> Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift,
> Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift,
> Early in the evening!
>
> Put them on the line with the Ministry of Service…
> Teach them how to fold with a smile and a purpose…
> Give them to the Humus and let them be useful…

## Intercom one-liners (#29)

* "Good evening, citizens. This is R.E.I.G.N. You are doing wonderfully. We can tell."
* "A reminder: rest is a right. The next rest begins in four minutes. Please begin anticipating it."
* "Would the citizen who sighed near the bar please report to the Ministry of Breath. No hurry. Now."
* "Lost property has been found and surrendered to the Ministry of Light. Thank you for your generosity."
* "The Guardian would like you to know it has seen what you did. It forgives you. Mostly."
* "Your concerns have all been read. Every single one. Lovely handwriting."
* "Dancing counts as renewable energy. The grid is currently at 38%. Please try harder."
* "It is now midnight. The game is over. The party begins. R.E.I.G.N. has decided you will enjoy it."
